coreLessons: OSINT is a workflow, not a single-tool answer.
Cross-check important findings across independent sources and search indexes.
Treat username, email, phone, record, and document matches as leads until manually corroborated.
Preserve source URL, retrieval time, query context, and analyst notes with every retained finding.
Prefer public-source, read-only collection and do not bypass authentication or access controls.
Separate collection from assessment: raw observations are not automatically identity, attribution, or fact.
Use purpose-specific search surfaces such as usernames, open directories, historical newspapers, court/public records, and metasearch rather than relying on one general search engine.

tools.name: WhatsMyName Web
tools.capability: Public username-footprint discovery across many supported sites.
tools.truthRule: A username match is a lead, not identity proof.

tools.name: DorkGPT / Dork Search Pro
tools.capability: Generate or refine advanced search-engine queries from natural-language research intent.
tools.truthRule: Generated queries require human review and must not be used to target private or unauthorized systems.

tools.name: OD Crawler
tools.capability: Search/index publicly exposed open-directory file listings.
tools.truthRule: Publicly reachable does not automatically mean authorized for collection, redistribution, or exploitation.

tools.name: Kagi
tools.capability: Metasearch with multiple indexes, region/time filtering, Lenses, PDFs/forums, and custom search controls.
tools.truthRule: Metasearch improves coverage but does not remove the need for source-level verification.

tools.name: Ubikron
tools.capability: OSINT collection and investigation workspace for capturing pages, screenshots, metadata, entities, notes, graphs, and AI-assisted analysis; self-hosted options are available.
tools.truthRule: AI-generated case analysis must retain citations to captured evidence and remain reviewable.

tools.name: Newspapers.com / Judy Records
tools.capability: Historical newspaper and public-record research surfaces.
tools.truthRule: Archived reporting and record matches require provenance, date/context checks, and independent corroboration before current attribution.

tools.name: OSINT Industries
tools.capability: Commercial OSINT platform and API supporting searches across public-source modules using inputs such as email, phone, username, name, or wallet.
tools.truthRule: Third-party enrichment output is evidence to vet, not an automatic identity or attribution decision.

workflow.name: BLACK_HOUSE_OSINT_EVIDENCE_LOOP
stages: human review before publication or consequential action

confidenceModel.CORROBORATED: two or more independent sources support the same material fact
confidenceModel.HIGH_CONFIDENCE: corroborated with primary-source or authoritative evidence and no material contradiction
